subject: Follow-up: Encryption / KMS options for Paywise integration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@paywise.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Encryption / KMS options for Paywise integration

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the next steps we discussed: 

1) Summary of requirements you called out:
- PII classification: customer names, payment metadata, and some transaction notes are considered regulated PII for Paywise.
- Data residency: production data must reside in the EU region (primary) with failover to us-west for DR; no cross-border replication of raw PII without explicit consent.
- Retention: default retention is 7 years for transaction logs; ability to set per-tenant retention is required.
- Logging and audit: detailed access audit trails + exportable logs for compliance audits.
- Encryption: in-transit TLS required; at-rest encryption with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) is strongly preferred + Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) / key rotation support.

2) What Redwood can provide (short):
- TLS in-transit by default.
- At-rest encryption using customer-managed keys via KMS integration (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault) or HSM-backed keys for Private deployments.
- Per-tenant key scoping and ability to rotate keys without downtime (depends on deployment mode).
- Audit logs and retention controls in Console; exportable to your SIEM.

3) Immediate next steps we agreed:
- I'll share our KMS capability brief and Security PSG (attached).
- You'll confirm whether Paywise requires FIPS/HSM for key storage or if KMS with BYOK is sufficient.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with our security engineer (Rishi) to go through key lifecycle, access controls, and deployment topology.
- Procurement will send a typical SOW / security questionnaire, cc'd if helpful.

Attachments: redwood-kms-overview.pdf, redwood-security-psg.docx

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive (PT): Mon 4/19 10-11am, Tue 4/20 9-10am or Wed 4/21 2-3pm. Let me know what works and whether you want Rishi to cover HSM specifics or our platform lead to join for Dedicated/Private deployment questions.

Thanks, talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

> Thanks for a great overview earlier.

> - Sanjay

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@paywise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@paywise.com <procurement@paywise.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Encryption / KMS options for Paywise integration

Marissa,

Appreciate the summary, that matches my notes. A few clarifications from the security and procurement side: 

- KMS/HSM: For our regulated payment flows we prefer HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) for the customer-managed key material. If Redwood can support HSM-backed BYOK in Dedicated or Private deployments, that's ideal. If only KMS is supported in the hosted mode, we need to understand the difference in guarantees.
- Key rotation: must support out-of-band rotation with a rollback plan if a rotation causes an issue.
- Data residency: EU-only for PII (we can provide a list of EU regions you support). Backups must also respect residency.
- Retention: yes, 7 years for transaction logs; we'll want per-tenant controls.

Procurement (procurement@paywise.com) will follow up with the standard security questionnaire and a copy of our vendor onboarding doc.

Can we lock in Tue 4/20 09:00 PT for the technical call with Rishi? If so, please send a calendar invite and dial-in.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Security & Compliance | Paywise Inc.
sanjay@paywise.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@paywise.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@paywise.com <procurement@paywise.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Encryption / KMS options for Paywise integration

Thanks Sanjay, locking in Tue 4/20 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent (link in invite).

Rishi, looping you in to cover HSM/BYOK specifics, key rotation/rollback, and tenant key scoping. High level notes for the call: 
- Paywise requires FIPS/HSM-backed key storage where possible; if hosted API cannot provide HSM, we should document the differences and mitigations (attestation, KMS SLA, encryption in transit + split knowledge).
- Confirm backup and snapshot residency guarantees and retention controls.
- Discuss operational runbooks for key rotation and emergency rollback.

Sanjay / Procurement, attached the KMS brief again and our security PSG. Also linking our internal KMS FAQ (read-only): https://drive.google.com/redwood/kms-faq

Action items: 
- Paywise: confirm HSM requirement vs KMS BYOK acceptance prior to the call (Sanjay).
- Redwood: Rishi to prepare a one-page KMS/HSM comparison and a short runbook draft for rotation/rollback (Rishi).
- Procurement: please send the vendor onboarding doc / questionnaire; we'll start answers ahead of the call.

Thanks all, see you Tue.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa / Neha,

Thanks, I've pulled together the initial notes for the call and the one-pager (attached to my calendar invite). Quick summary of what I'll cover on Tue: 

- Support matrix: Hosted API (Redwood-managed KMS) vs Dedicated (customer KMS via cloud KMS + optional HSM) vs Private (HSM-backed on-prem integration).
- Key scoping: per-tenant envelope keys, CMK storage, and access policies.
- Rotation/rollback approach: dual-key rollout + shadow signing, test rotation on non-prod, and emergency-rekey playbook.
- Backups & snapshots: encryption-at-rest with customer keys where supported; ensure backups stay in EU buckets for Paywise.

Actionable items I'm tracking: 
1) Prepare KMS/HSM comparison doc (done).
2) Share sample access policy and minimal IAM bindings for CMK usage.
3) Confirm which EU regions in hosted offer residency guarantees (follow-up with infra team before the call).

I'll be ready to deep-dive Tue 09:00 PT.

-r
